headline: End of Session I, IHSG Falls 0.49% to Level 5.216
summary: The Indonesian Composite Index (IHSG) fell 0.49% to 5,216 on 25 November 2026, under selling pressure. Sentiment was influenced by corporate results and US inflation data.
why: The IHSG is Indonesia's main stock index, tracking all listed companies on the Indonesia Stock Exchange. US inflation data affects global rate expectations and emerging-market flows.
why_moved: The index fell on selling pressure, with the input citing corporate earnings and US inflation data as factors shaping sentiment.
original_headline: Akhir Sesi I, IHSG Turun 0,49% ke Level 5.216
